s.x: A sea creature surfaces at your bobber and comes for you, with Hypixel's name, level, health and catch message ("You caught a Sea Walker.").
Fishing rods hit sea creatures twice as hard.
Whoever kills one gets its coins, its drops (rare ones are announced with their odds) and its
, which is where most Fishing XP comes from. Sea creatures killed on a private island give no Fishing XP.
Which one comes up depends on your Fishing level and where you fish; rarer ones are much less likely:
